source: GitHub Innovation Graph (data files of 2020 Q1 – 2026 Q1); population: UN World Population Prospects 2024
license: CC0 1.0 (GitHub Innovation Graph); CC BY 3.0 IGO (UN WPP 2024)
method: Q1 of each year. Developers, organizations and repositories are counts at the end of the quarter; git pushes and collaboration are counts during the quarter. Location is GitHub's IP-based economy. The EU rows (sums of the 27 member states) are dropped. Per-capita uses mid-year population (projections from 2024). Growth (developers a year earlier) and pushes per developer need at least 1000 developers.
